text.autoconfig.simplefun.option.fun.pla: If enabled, players drop their head when killed by another player. Default: true. Server-owned; restart required.
text.autoconfig.simplefun.option.fun.ena: Eating (cooked) porkchop turns the player into a pig for 5 minutes. Default: true. Server-owned; restart required.
Feathers and the No-Damage enchantment make player melee attacks deal 0 damage (knockback still applies). Default: true. Server-owned; restart required.
Allows throwing items far while sneaking (Sneak + Q). Default: true. Server-owned; restart required.
text.autoconfig.simplefun.option.fun.yee: Velocity multiplier when throwing items while sneaking. Default: 3.0. Server-owned; restart required.
text.autoconfig.simplefun.option.fun.ena: If enabled, Bricks, Nether Bricks and Resin Bricks can be thrown. Default: true. Server-owned; restart required.
text.autoconfig.simplefun.option.fun.thr: Breaks only ordinary/stained glass in single-player, subject to server protection and world border. Disabled on dedicated multiplayer servers to avoid claim bypass. Default: false.
text.autoconfig.simplefun.option.fun.bri: Damage dealt by thrown bricks. Default: 2.0. Server-owned; restart required.

jei.simplefun.head_source: Only a charged creeper explosion killing the animal drops this head. One head per creeper. No crafting recipe. Wear it, place on a floor/wall, or put it above a note block.
jei.simplefun.brick_snowball: Four snowballs around a brick. Throw with use; the server enforces damage and cooldown caps.
